title: 66 Downtown Nashville ~ Riverfront~Sleeps 6 ~ Pool
description:
2 bedrooms - 2 King beds and a queen sleeper sofa in living room
2 full bathrooms
Kitchen with pots, pans, plates, etc
Keurig - uses K-Cup's
Free Covered Parking
Pool 
Fitness Room 
Laundry Room
2 blocks from First Tennessee Ballpark and Germantown
15-20 minute walk to Broadway, Honky Tonks, Nissan Stadium, The Ryman, Ascend Amphitheater, Bicentennial Mall State Park

*We have 2 more rentals in the same development if interested.

The space
This condo will have everything you need: 2 King Beds in their own bedrooms,  and a Queen Sleeper sofa in the living room. 2 Full Bathrooms (one has a shower/tub combo and the other has a shower) All sheets and bedding provided. Towels, hand towels and wash clothes - make sure you bring your pool towels. Balcony overlooks the river. TV with Cable in Living Room and 32 inch TV's in bedrooms. Hair dryer. All pots, pans, dishes and utensils for cooking at home. Keurig and coffee mugs - Bring your preferred K-Pods). Ironing board, iron and hangers.  Cable Internet/Wifi. Swimming Pool. Fitness Room. Laundry room. FREE Covered Parking. The condo is located on the 3rd floor (no elevator).

Guest access
You will be able to access the entire unit, pool, fitness center and laundry room. You may also use the fire-pit (please put the fire out completely before leaving) and the gas grill.

Other things to note
The condo is located on the 3rd floor. There is no elevator in the building. Two flights of stairs are directly in front of the condo. We are located downtown so you may hear sirens, train horns and barge traffic at times. Welcome to the city!

**Disclaimer about the community amenities (pool, laundry room & gym). Please be advised that from time to time there may be an instance where the pool, laundry room and/or gym may be shut down for scheduled maintenance and/or for safety reasons, and there is a possibility that it could happen during your stay. Please note that I do not have any control over that and will not be held responsible for a community amenity closing. If it is brought to my attention by the HOA that there will be a closing for any of the community amenities during your stay, I will do my very best to provide you with as much advanced notice as I can. Thank you for your understanding!

host_details:
Hello and thank you for checking out our riverfront condos located in downtown Nashville, TN. 

I sell real estate full time and enjoy hosting guest from around the world in our 3 AirBnB's located in downtown Nashville.  We have two - 2 bedroom/2 bathroom condos (right on the river with awesome views) and a 1 bedroom/1 bathroom condo located in the same development. I lived in the development for 10 years and the location cannot be beat.  We are less than 1 mile away from Broadway, Bridgestone Arena, The Ryman, Ascend Amphitheater, Tennessee State Capitol, Bicentennial Mall State Park, First Tennessee Ballpark, Nissan Stadium and more! The Germantown neighborhood is only a few blocks away.  Waking up to the sun reflecting off of the Cumberland River everyday is beautiful. It is so peaceful at times it's hard to believe it is downtown.  Riverfront Condominiums won many awards as the developer repurposed the structure of a pre-WWII warehouse and kept it in place as a parking structure. Take a look and let me know if you have any questions!
